title: Short allocation reporting (NSE Clearing)

columns.name: Indicator
columns.note: Snapshot number (1-n) or E that gave the highest short allocation

columns.name: TotalCollateral
columns.note: cash + non-cash + excess of other segment

columns.name: ReasonCode
columns.note: 01 excess collateral with another CC; 02 early pay-in of securities sold; 03 trades in wrong client code (intraday); 04 NRI trades; 05 allocation accepted late (intraday); 06 re-pledge not yet processed (intraday); 07 custodian early pay-in of funds (intraday)

columns.name: CC Code
columns.note: the other clearing corporation, only with reason code 01

linked: Written from the SA04 rows with the reasons recorded on Clearing data
source: NSE Clearing circular NCL/CMPT/53919 (30 Sep 2022): reporting of short allocation of collaterals; reason codes NCL/CMPT/55381 and 56494
